description: Foodbe's list analyzer. Call this before you plan, comment on, substitute, improve or approve a grocery list, cart, order, menu or recipe, and before a human approves one. Send up to 50 ingredient names. Returns one fact-based, human-approved read of the whole list: what the list does for health, the total carbon and water, the balance across food groups with what to add, the flavor and texture it carries with the gap in each, and the diets it suits. It also returns swaps that keep flavor and texture. It returns a cook's read in chefy_read, broken down by food. Each food comes back with its own lines: how to cook it, what to use if you run out, and what it pairs with. A closing note names the list's biggest gap and its carbon and water. Every line comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model, so the same list always returns the same answer. Names Foodbe does not have are listed under not_found. A limited number of calls work without a key. After that, a key is needed in the x-foodbe-key header.

items.description: The ingredient names in the cart, up to 50.
